body: H1, for the Admiral's reading. Sciences returned its checked closure plan at 10:43, ahead of the 16:00 due time. Una (XO) has no remaining objection after round 2, and there is no round 3. I ruled two things. FIRST, the OU amendment is DECLARED. For the one dimple component comparison, a certified reconstruction of the source's own continuum equations replaces the source-supplied comparison value, because the historical curve carries no discretization-error bound. The source plot stays as a separate even-parity check. It is prospective, made before any calculated response. The source scores are unchanged, no source criterion becomes MET, and nothing claims full H1. Declining it would have left the reference route unbound with no way forward. SECOND, the preparation-only card is FUNDED at a cap of 10200 seat-budget seconds: a builder at 6300 s on proofs and a fit package, Una at 900 s as a blind second plot reader (sealed first), and Una at 3000 s on proof review afterwards. There is no payload, native call or new seat. Research-grade proofs may fail at the first gate; that returns an exact blocker, not a physical FAIL. Any reference or native run needs a fresh card. ref-1815c7acbe44d85cbcd0 reads 81% 7d at burn 3.02; at 90% the builder goes to the existing grok lead. Native design is still due 10-20 12:00. No stall pause; the 10-22 report stays due.
